Case reference: 2008005099.CaseDesc: On January 26, 1976 Robert McDonald’s employer reported that he didn’t show up for work and hadn’t been seen since January 16,1976. Robert was seen hitchhiking south out of Ear Falls on Highway 105 on January 28,1976. He was last seen at Griffith Mines, north of Ear Falls, ON.

Jacket: Blue, White, skidoo with white stripes

Case reference: 2023041781.CaseDesc: On or about March 21, 2018 Daniel Chambers was last seen in the area of Niagara Falls, New York, USA. At the time of his disappearance, Daniel was despondent.

Case reference: 2018040315.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1992, at approximately 9:00am, Joshua Hill was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2013000124.CaseDesc: Maxwell Brown is from Bella Bella and traveled to Klemtu to look for work in late April 2012.  He was last seen in Klemtu on May 1, 2012.

Hat: Black, BASEBALL, Baseball cap with "C" on front
Tattoo: Left Side Of Neck, "REST IN PEACE"

Case reference: 2016061831.CaseDesc: On September 1, 1980, a caucasian male, believed to be between the ages of 50 to 65 years old, was found at the bottom of the fourth floor stairway of the parking garage at 50 Cumberland Avenue in Yorkville, Toronto. He had trauma to his face and skull possibly due to a fall down the stairs. His appendix was present and he was circumcised.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Short, Beard of a couple of days
Teeth: Visible Missing, Many of his teeth were lost some time before death and some of the remaining teeth had cavities. He had no dental work.
Pants: Brown, Blue, Light brown, plaid, Levi's brand
Shirt: Yellow, Long sleeved sport shirt with "Stevenson 114" written on the inside of the collar
Shorts: Light Blue, Dark Blue, Checkered, size 30 from Sears

Case reference: 2016061151.CaseDesc: On April 29, 2014, a male was recovered from a reservoir behind Energy Ottawa, building #511 at 4 Booth Street, Ottawa. His appendix and gallbladder are present. It is believed that he had been in the water for a few days to a few months.

Hair: Brown, Medium length; balding and face stuble
Teeth: Extensive amount of dental work including root canal, crowns, posts and composite resin fillings.
Other: Red, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 2 disposable lighters
cigarettes in a white opaque plastic container
a hand drawn map of the Richmond Rd/Churchill Ave area, drawn on a torn off cover of a notepad
folding knife with built in nail file and opener on a ring
3 keys (SM "ILCO" key, Curtis "SC1" & Oscar "WR3" house keys)

Case reference: 2012020107.CaseDesc: Isabelle Bourgeot, 32, was seen for the last time on November 1st, 1985 in the La Cité-Limoilou district in Quebec City, Quebec. At the time of her disappearance Isabelle wasn’t carrying any identification papers. It should be noted that she suffers from amnesia.

Case reference: 2008016999.CaseDesc: Meryl Newcombe and George Weeden were last seen and reported missing to the White River OPP on October 29, 1959.  The two men had been at a lodge operated by Meryl at Mile 107 of the CPR line, west of Chapleau, Ontario. Meryl and George had planned a hunting trip and both were last seen between mile marker 106 and 107 of the CPR line southeast of White River and west of Chapleau. A large- scale search was conducted at the time, and again the following Spring (1960). The search failed to locate them, and to this day, they have not been located. George’s exact date of birth is not known, but the year of birth is understood to be 1896 or 1897.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Leg, injured in a train wreck in 1941

Case reference: 2014004345.CaseDesc: Thomas Brock was reported missing in September 1999 after family and friends became concerned as they had not had contact with him since June 2009. Thomas was last seen in the Goose Lake and Barrhead regions of Alberta.

Case reference: 2006018099.CaseDesc: On January 4, 1994, David Ernest Rowbotham was last seen in the Belleville/Trenton Ontario area.

Case reference: 2014002549.CaseDesc: Wladyslaw Klisko was last seen on September 11, 1983 in Montreal, Quebec. Wladyslaw left his house in the morning and boarded a bus to go to church but he was never seen at the church.

Case reference: 2012020079.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1991, Lavina Tocher was last seen in Parkman, Saskatchewan. On the 12th of December of that year, she was reported missing. Investigation and searches have failed to locate her.

Case reference: 2014005156.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2002, Jeanne Ouellette was seen for the last time at a Starbucks coffeehouse in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006016999.CaseDesc: Donald Hemsworth was last seen in the area between Twitchgrass and Hilda Lakes, Farr Township, in the Temiskaming Region of Ontario on October 8, 1974.

Case reference: 2006005599.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1980, Foster Bezanson departed the Abitibi Road 48 area near Cochrane, Ontario to go hunting and he never returned.

Case reference: 2014004143.CaseDesc: Ruth Clarke was last seen in the High Park district of Edmonton, Alberta, on November 1, 1990. She was reported missing to the police on November 12, 1990. She left her cane, glasses and daily heart medication at home. Ruth is known to visit the communities of Lloydminster, Killam, Leduc and Kananaskis in Alberta.

Case reference: 2014001030.CaseDesc: On July 6, 1994, the body of an adult male believed to be between the ages of 25 and 35 was found in the waters of the St. Lawrence River near the Old Port of Montreal Clock Tower in Montreal, Quebec.

Sweater: Cotton, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, "Fruit of the Loom" brand, T-shirt with short sleeves, faded, size medium
Scar: Right Hand, 2.4 cm at the base of the thumb

Case reference: 2012020013.CaseDesc: Angeline Pete was last seen on May 26, 2011 leaving her residence in North Vancouver, BC.  Miss Pete's disappearance is suspicious and foul play cannot be excluded.

Hair: Brown, Long, Dyed, Often dyes it

Case reference: 2015012392.CaseDesc: Cuong Tu was last seen on March 11, 2015 on the south side of Edmonton, Alberta.  Cuong is described as being 5’4” tall and 124 pounds. He was last seen wearing black track pants, a black track-style jacket, and white runners.

Case reference: 2014001538.CaseDesc: During the month of March, 1998, Theresa Johnny was seen for the last time in Whitehorse, Yukon. The last known contact with Theresa was on July 18, 1998, with the Anchorage Police Department in Alaska, United States. Over the years, there have been a number of unconfirmed tips received about Theresa’s location and well being.

Case reference: 2014002936.CaseDesc: On February 3, 1988, David Ambroise, then 3 years old, was playing near the Saint-Maurice River in the First Nations reserve of Wemotaci, Quebec. David approached too close to the water, slipped and fell in. He was then swept away by the current, and has never been found despite searches.

Case reference: 2022064778.CaseDesc: Justin McMillan was last seen at his home in Keswick Ridge, New Brunswick, on December 19th, 2022. Law enforcement has explored numerous avenues to locate Justin with no success.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Puffy style winter jacket
Tattoo: Left Eye, Tear drop and cross

Case reference: 2014005537.CaseDesc: Kerry Klyne was last seen working at the Dakota Hotel in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  Kerry made a withdrawal from his Peace Hills Trust account on November 15, 2010 and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Tattoo: Right Shoulder, Tribal art/Band around biceps

Case reference: 2015059939.CaseDesc: On October 20, 1973, the remains of a male were recovered from the water near the Fleet Street Pumping Station, Ottawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being between 170-180lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.  It is estimated that he had been in the water between 2 and 3 months.

Case reference: 2023024770.CaseDesc: Sebastien Lagace was obliged to reside at the Domaine Orford treatment center in Sherbrooke, Quebec, in accordance with the terms of his court order. On the evening of December 23, 2022, Sebastien exited the facility on foot, carrying his backpack. Sebastien's parents reported him missing on May 19, 2023, as they had not heard from him since his voluntary departure from Domaine Orford.

Case reference: 2006011299.CaseDesc: Henry Atlookan left Whiteclay Lake in a canoe to travel 55 km to Armstrong, Ontario. He may have been seen on June 25, 1968 making a purchase at a local store in the Town of Armstrong. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004992.CaseDesc: On October 12, 2004, at approximately 11:30 a.m., Kim Evans was seen for the last time at the North York Women’s Shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Kim had said she was going to her family’s residence to collect her personal belongings.

Pierce: Nose, Nose ring on the right side

Case reference: 2014001059.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1970, the body of a heavyset young adult male with black hair was found on the shore of Kamloops Lake in British Columbia. He had all his teeth removed during his life and had no noticeable scars or tattoos. He is believed to have drowned in the Thompson River near Riverside Park a few days earlier.

Jacket: Nylon, Light Blue, Squall brand with hood, golfer label on front with zipper
Shirt: Blue, Yellow, Corsair brand, checkered pattern
Blue, Longsleeve, Lancer Brand, Size Large, Blue with purple and black check pattern, longsleeve
White, Bluestone brand, long sleeves, size medium
Shoes: Brown, Oxfords, Vibram brand, made in Italy, with shoe laces

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2006005399.CaseDesc: In October 1956, Charles Ombash and his brother Tom Ombash left the Pelican Falls Residential School near Sioux Lookout, Ontario. Their plan was to canoe back to Cat Lake, or to take the train to Savant Lake, hitchhike to Pickle Lake and then canoe on to Cat Lake. The family has not had any contact with them since that time.

Case reference: 2016030649.CaseDesc: Kean Luo was originally from Malaysia, but relocated to the United States to attend school and begin his career. He relocated to Winnipeg, Manitoba on March 2, 2016, for professional reasons. Concerns were raised by friends and family when Kean was not available to receive calls or messages for an extended period of time. However, on April 2, 2016, police spoke with Kean at a local hotel in Kenora, Ontario. He stated that he was not considering ending his own life, but was experiencing stress and missing his family. His vehicle was subsequently discovered parked on the shoulder of the highway on the Sergeant Thomas Cooper Bridge (Kenora). All mobile phone and banking activity has since ceased.

Case reference: 2014001191.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2010, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Richelieu River in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2022055316.CaseDesc: Jesse Strongarm was last seen in November 2021 in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. At the time of this disappearance, Jesse was living a high-risk lifestyle. After communicating with a friend in December 2021 Jesse has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2006020599.CaseDesc: Simon Angeconeb was last seen on July 10, 1993 at Cat Island Lodge located on Red Lake in the District of Kenora, Ontario. He was heading to his cabin to go to sleep and has not been seen since. He may have been suffering from a concussion.

Case reference: 2024061875.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2024, the Beaumont RCMP received a report that Shawn Edward Robson-Harder had not been seen in Beaumont since September 19, 2024. He had a history of frequenting major cities and First Nations throughout Alberta.  However, had never gone this long without checking in with friends. Shawn's friends and family are concerned for his well-being.

Case reference: 2022032399.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2022, partial skeletal remains of this man were found in a forested area near Salmon Arm, British Columbia. He had a severe fracture to his right lower leg during life, which required surgical intervention. He likely died many months to years before his remains were found.

Foreign Object: Right Leg, fracture to right tibia with surgical implant

Case reference: 2018046253.CaseDesc: On January 31, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Daphne Powell was seen for the last time as she left her residence in Toronto, Ontario. Daphne left her residence with two suitcases, some money and indicated that she was going to Jamaica.

Case reference: 2013000023.CaseDesc: Marilyn Ann Hersey was last seen on January 28, 2006, outside the Abbie J. Lane Memorial Building on Veterans Memorial Lane in Halifax, Nova Scotia.  Marilyn was due to return to the hospital but never did and was not seen again.  Marilyn needs to take daily medications to treat numerous ailments which she did not take with her after leaving the hospital.

Hair: Blonde, Grey, Wavy blonde and greying hair

Case reference: 2011005499.CaseDesc: Lukas was last seen on October 3, 2011, heading into the bushes behind Chomista Trailer park. His duffle bag was located in the bushes with his personal property on October 7, 2011. He was en route to his sister's place, but never arrived. Lukas has ties to Winnipeg and Calgary.

Case reference: 2008006299.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1960, Willie Ray was reported missing. He had left his residence approximately 3 weeks earlier. It was common for him to go hunting and fishing. Willie was reportedly very comfortable living in the outdoors and could sustain himself for quite sometime. There was a 12 gauge shotgun missing from the Ray residence. The boats frequently used by Willie were all accounted for.

Case reference: 2011002199.CaseDesc: Sean Tan was last seen on March 7, 2011, at his residence in an apartment building on Huron Street in Toronto, Ontario. Sean may have been despondent at the time.

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2016032179.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1944, Richard David Marlow was seen for the last time riding his bike in front of his family’s home in Etobicoke, Ontario. Later that evening, when Richard’s mother returned home, his bike was found at the house. Richard was a good child at home, and in school, and had no reason to run away.

Socks: Cotton, Grey, Yellow band at top

Case reference: 2006003399.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2001, this male, was found in a sewer at 470 Lansdowne Avenue in Toronto. His ancestry is Caucasian, possibly Egyptian or mixed African/Caucasian. He had previous surgery of his left forearm, which had involved the implant of surgical plates. The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Teeth were stained, which suggests he may have been a smoker,  his upper central incisors were also missing
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

Case reference: 2017068602.CaseDesc: On August 13, 2017, Martin Bertram McLearn was seen for the last time in South Rawdon, Nova Scotia. Martin has moderate dementia and was reported missing from his home.

Boots: Rubber, Size 7; old, worn and cracked

Case reference: 2025038452.CaseDesc: Normand Basque has not been seen by his family since the 2010s and was previously living in Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec. Normand leads a nomadic lifestyle and his family has no photos of him as an adult. The last time the family heard from Normand, he was traveling and possibly living in the United States of America.

Case reference: 2010003599.CaseDesc: Alexander McAuley was reported missing by family members on April 23, 2010, after not having any contact with him since 2002. Alexander was known to lead a high risk lifestyle and may have met with foul play.

Case reference: 2014004626.CaseDesc: In March of 1975, Barry “Rocky” Fiddler was reported missing by his family when he failed to return home.  It was learned that he was last seen in July of 1975 at a Powwow at the Thunderchild First Nation, Saskatchewan, which is approximately 1.5 hours from Meadow Lake, Saskatchewan.  Investigation and searches have failed to locate him.

Case reference: 2017056036.CaseDesc: On July 9, 2017, Jason McGrath was last seen modifying his kayak at the family's cottage in Cape George, Nova Scotia. Jason had indicated that he intended on taking the kayak out onto the water. The kayak and Jason’s other personal belongings were recovered on a shore in Judique, Nova Scotia.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Red circle with flames

Case reference: 2019056482.CaseDesc: On the evening of September 26, 2019, Gregory Paul Agnew was seen for the last time in his green Pontiac Sunfire, leaving a mushroom picker’s camp located at the 11km mark on the Kinsckutch Forest Service Road in New Aiyansh, to run errands in Terrace, British Columbia. On the evening of September 27, 2019, the Pontiac Sunfire was observed at his campsite along with his camper van, but Gregory was not there. An extensive search of the area was conducted with no success. Gregory has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2013000025.CaseDesc: Darwin Sylvester was last seen at approximately 11 p.m. on May 28, 1998, in Brandon, Manitoba. He contacted his partner shortly after 12:00 a.m. on May 29th to inform her of his intention to meet with an associate for breakfast; however, he failed to attend the meeting. All of his personal belongings and luggage were located at a residence on Chalmers Road. We have not been able to establish any contact with Darwin since that time.

Tattoo: Left Arm, "Spartans MC in Memory of" (text)

Case reference: 2014005286.CaseDesc: Karl Behr was last seen on December 25, 1981, in Edmonton, Alberta, when he left a family function to return to his residence. It was noted that Karl's green parka and winter boots were missing from his home. Karl speaks with a slight German accent.

Case reference: 2006010199.CaseDesc: Donald Chorney was last seen departing the Keys Lake Campground near Grassy Narrows, Ontario, to go for a boat ride.  He has not been seen since and is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2025022621.CaseDesc: At 10:01 a.m., on May 2nd, 2025, Jack and Lilly Sullivan were reported missing from their rural home on Gairloch Road, in Lansdowne, Nova Scotia. Jack and Lilly’s mother reported the children had last been seen that morning at approximately 7:00 a.m. - 7:30 a.m., and were noticed missing from the house at approximately 9:40 a.m. Extensive search initiatives began immediately utilizing RCMP, GSAR, Air Services, Police Dog Services and drones but have yielded negative results thus far.

Case reference: 2013000097.CaseDesc: On January 25, 1981, police received a call regarding the drowning of Deanne Bousquet. Three children were playing on the ice on the river when two of the children broke through. Deanne was unable to pull herself out and was last seen going under the water. Ice in the area was very thin due to warm water being dumped by the mill. All efforts made to locate Deanne were negative.

Case reference: 2014004457.CaseDesc: Stephon Payne was last seen at his residence on October 6, 2002. On the same day, Stephon was seen in the area of 106 Avenue and 84 Street, Edmonton, Alberta. Stephon may have also been in the area of the Dawson Bridge in Edmonton. A jacket believed to be Stephon’s was found at the bridge.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Heart with dagger

Case reference: 2023014476.CaseDesc: Paul Hahn left his Amherst, New York home on April 21st, 2022 to go kayaking on Lake Ontario near Golden State Hill Park, New York, USA. At the time of his disappearance, he was in possession of an orange and black Old Towne Sportsman motorized 120 kayak. His vehicle was located unoccupied in the state park however Paul has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2018042433.CaseDesc: Veta Rostas was last seen leaving a Children Aid Society home in Brampton, Ontario on July 28, 2018.  There is reason to believe that Veta may be in the state of Maryland, USA or in Romania with her parents, Pardelian Rostas and Bacrii Rostas.

Shirt: Black, Red, T-shirt, black with red writing

Case reference: 2008003599.CaseDesc: Charlie Campbell was last seen November 6, 1988 in Red Lake Ontario.  It is believed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2014005532.CaseDesc: On September 20, 1984, Emily Koble had been picked up by two ladies that felt she had appeared lost and confused. Emily was dropped off near Christopher Lake, Saskatchewan when she asked to get out of the vehicle. The ladies called the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, however, a search failed to locate her.

Deformity: Shoulders, Steel pin, unknown which shoulder

Case reference: 2012000299.CaseDesc: Cheryl Rowe was last seen by her family on December 22, 2011, just after 12:00 a.m. on Rathfon Crescent, Richmond Hill, Ontario. Investigators believe that Cheryl may be the victim of foul play.

Tattoo: Upper Back, Children's names, two wings with the words "Shane" and "Christina"

Case reference: 2014008479.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2014 William Grange was on vacation at the Cambridge Beach Resort and Spa in Bermuda. In the evening, he walked away from the resort.

Jewelry: Gold, wedding band with one diamond
Scar: Unknown, Small white scar, approx. 3" long, on top of hand, unknown right or left hand
Left Side Of Head, Surgical scar on left side of head/scalp from brain surgery

Case reference: 2014005323.CaseDesc: Darrell Hoshowski was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta, in July 1983. Prior to his disappearance, Darrell had made a withdrawal from his bank account. There is reason to believe that he may have travelled to Vancouver, British Columbia or possibly to the State of California, in the USA.

Case reference: 2014005915.CaseDesc: On October 30, 2012, at approximately 8:00 a.m., Frank Fuernkranz was seen for the last time on vacation in Panama. Frank had left to go for a walk, but never returned.

Case reference: 2014001530.CaseDesc: Ronald Nodeland was last seen by his family on August 20, 1978, at his residence in Edson, Alberta. His motorcycle and helmet were found approximately one month later in a remote region southwest of Sundre, Alberta. Ronald may have been observed on foot in the vicinity shortly afterward, however he was never located.

Case reference: 2014003528.CaseDesc: Kate Huyghe was last seen in Killam, Alberta on February 21, 1976.

Boots: Leather, Black, winter boot with suede fur tops
Jewelry: Metal, Gold, family ring with colored stone

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2014002890.CaseDesc: On January 6, 1983, Bertha Kolachynski was last seen at her residence in the community of Chippawa in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Bertha was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2014042438.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2014, at approximately 6:00 p.m., Delaram Hashemi was seen for the last time leaving her home in Toronto, Ontario. Delaram had told her mother that she would be attending a party and would return home at 10:00 p.m., but she never returned.

Case reference: 2025030657.CaseDesc: Lyndsay McKinney was last seen on July 5, 1991, just after 10 a.m.  He was in a sailboat off the coast of Youngstown, New York, heading back to Toronto, Ontario.  Shortly after, a storm blew in, throwing him from the boat into Lake Ontario.  Lyndsay has not been found and is believed drowned.

Case reference: 2020032400.CaseDesc: On April 1, 2019, Samantha Hiebert was seen for the last time by her friends and family in the area of Powerview-Pine Falls, Manitoba. During the time of her disappearance, Samantha had been seen at the Sagkeeng Employment and Income Assistance Office.

Case reference: 2016008144.CaseDesc: Ben Trommels was last seen at his residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario, after being dropped off at 6:00 p.m. on Thursday, February 11, 2016.  It is believed that he left his apartment on foot that evening.  At the time of his disappearance, Ben suffered from mental health issues.

Hair: Brown, Often has a shaved head
Coat: Black, Winter coat with fur trimmed hood

Case reference: 2014004588.CaseDesc: On November 23, 1986, Pierre-Jean Durocher was last seen at a rooming house in Longueuil, Quebec. Pierre-Jean was reported missing on November 25, 1986, by a family member. Pierre-Jean's backpack containing his identification was later found on the Jacques Cartier Bridge in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002754.CaseDesc: Charles Williams was last seen on coastal waters offshore from Cartwright, Newfoundland & Labrador on November 3rd, 1963.  Charles was operating a 12 foot outboard motorboat and did not return home.

Case reference: 2014002474.CaseDesc: Allan "Kenley" Matheson was a student at Acadia University, in Wolfville, Nova Scotia in September 1992. On September 21, 1992 it was reported that Kenley was seen by a friend walking on Main Street in Wolfville. This was the last time anyone has seen Kenley.

Coat: Nylon, Blue, Helly Hansen, mountain coat, "Helly Hansen" brand
Jewelry: Metal, White, Watch, White face "Seiko" brand, 8M2571000, series number 040792

Case reference: 2014003230.CaseDesc: James McGrath was reported missing on May 31, 2001, by family members.  At the time of his disappearance he was residing near Patrick's Cove, Newfoundland & Labrador.  James lived alone, and was last seen walking on the roadway approximately seven days before his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004043.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2002, Eva Nakanjako, her husband Robert Mukwaya, and their son Emmanuel Mukwaya were last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Eva and Robert had not shown up for work for three weeks and had not paid their rent. During the time of their disappearance, their apartment was found partially emptied.

Case reference: 2022002122.CaseDesc: On January 3, 2022, at approximately 2:00 a.m., Karl Neff was seen for the last time leaving his residence in Port Colborne, Ontario. Karl has ties to the St. Catharines area in Ontario.

Case reference: 2012020045.CaseDesc: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) is seeking the public's assistance in locating Shirley Ann Waquan. Shirley was last seen on July 1, 2007 in Fort McMurray, Alberta.

Case reference: 2013000134.CaseDesc: Loretta (Lora) Ann Frank was last seen in Yukon Territory between late 1988 and early 1989. She was known to reside in Watson Lake and Whitehorse, Yukon as well as Lower Post, British Columbia. Loretta was reported missing in 1993. Loretta is known to have a history of mental health concerns.

Case reference: 2023064985.CaseDesc: Leslie Boyd was reported missing to police on November 16, 2023, from Fredericton, New Brunswick, a few days after having missed a court date. Investigation has revealed the last contact with Leslie was on November 7, 2023 when she was believed to be in the New Zion community of New Brunswick. Leslie is believed to be missing with another subject, Brady Storey, who has also been reported missing by family around the same time. Leslie was living a high-risk lifestyle at the time of her disappearance.

Sweater: Cotton, White, Text "Playboy" in black lettering
Tattoo: Right Ear, Heart, unknown behind which ear

Case reference: 2008000499.CaseDesc: Kimberley Ann Amero was last seen at her residence in Saint John, New Brunswick on September 3, 1985. There has been no contact with family or friends since.

Case reference: 2017056566.CaseDesc: Darryl Gundrum was last seen between March 1 and September 30, 1970, near Sherwood Park, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014002921.CaseDesc: Alban Robichaud has been missing since May 30, 1991 from Saint John, New Brunswick. Alban was employed with City Laundry and left his place of work at 3pm the day he went missing. Alban was seen in various uptown Saint John pubs and was last seen at Gene's Country Palace between 11:00 & 11:30 pm.

Case reference: 2014001312.CaseDesc: John McAllister was last seen leaving his home on May 7, 1973. The truck belonging to John was later found near Lodgepole, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014003086.CaseDesc: On January 30, 1997, Maurizio Di Caprio was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. Maurizio left for Chicoutimi, Quebec or Toronto, Ontario to bring back a vehicle to Montreal.

Case reference: 2008018099.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1974, at approximately 8:15 hours, Douglas Henderson and Alexander Korecki were canoeing in a 14 foot fiberglass canoe close to the shore in the area of Depot Harbor, Big Sound, in Georgian Bay. The canoe capsized approximately 500 feet away from the campsite.

Case reference: 2018054598.CaseDesc: On September 22nd, 2018, Dwayne Lavallee was seen for the last time in his vehicle leaving the Ebb and Flow First Nation community and the vehicle was located on September 26th, north of the community of Ste. Rose du Lac, Manitoba.

Jacket: Black, Yellow, Work jacket with reflective stripes

Case reference: 2006026799.CaseDesc: On Friday, May 19, 1967, at about 06:10 A.M,. Victor Morris left his cottage on the South Shore of Lake Nipissing in an 18 foot Geisler Cedar Strip boat with an 18 hp motor. On Sunday, May 21 1967, the boat was recovered on Manitou Island in Lake Nipissing. The boat was partially burnt and the motor showed signs of having exploded.

Case reference: 2022018590.CaseDesc: Xiao Hua Jiang, who goes by her English name “Christina”, was last seen at approximately 1am on April 27, 2022 in West Vancouver, British Columbia. On May 2, 2022, her vehicle, a grey 2021 Toyota Highlander was located abandoned on Highway 1, approximately 20 kilometres east of Rogers Pass, just outside Glacier National Park in British Columbia. The vehicle had sustained mechanical damage rendering it undriveable. Xiao Hua has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006023699.CaseDesc: Jeffrey Turtle was last seen in Pikangikum in the Squirrel Rock area in Ontario on July 4, 2005. Information received indicated that Jeffrey was going to a sand pit area approximately 3 km northwest of Pikangikum.

Hat: Blue, Red, Ball Cap, Red "C", Size Large
Sweater: Hooded, Size XL, Black, Red And White

Case reference: 2024055255.CaseDesc: In the fall of 1964, Eunice Bird was last seen getting into a yellow sports car in Prince Rupert, British Columbia.  Eunice has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2021015231.CaseDesc: On December 8, 2017, at approximately 1:06 p.m., James Ryding was seen for the last time as he left his apartment in Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, James may have been despondent.

Coat: Blue, Winter, Possibly wearing a puffy royal blue coat

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:
On September 18, 1978, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Toronto Harbour of Lake Ontario. His post-mortem weight was 163lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.
Staining on his teeth suggest that he may have been a smoker. It is estimated that he had been in the water for several weeks.

Teeth: Stained, Overbite & several amalgam fillings. Several teeth lost/extracted during life; lower right lateral incisor being most obvious.

Case reference: 2014005291.CaseDesc: On September 4, 1990, at approximately 6:50am, Ann Lylyck was last seen by her friend when he dropped her and her dog off at the Our Lady of Mercy Hospital in Toronto, Ontario. Ann was intending on visiting her aunt, but wanted to walk her dog before going into the hospital. When her friend returned a few hours later, Ann could not be located.

Case reference: 2014006241.CaseDesc: On September 7, 2013, at around 10 am, Ranjit Singh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Ranjit had travelled from India to visit Toronto and was due to return home on a flight scheduled for 5 pm, but he never boarded the plane.

Case reference: 2020011959.CaseDesc: On May 4, 1986, James Masten, Patricia Heys, Mark Smith, and Kimberly Masten were seen for the last time as they left Bluffer’s Park in Toronto, Ontario, on a 16-foot boat. The four were heading out onto Lake Ontario.

Scar: Right Eye, 2 inch scar over right eye

Case reference: 2014000022.CaseDesc: Cynthia Albena Audy was last seen getting into a vehicle in the North End area of Winnipeg, Manitoba on October 28th, 2004.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Heart and cross

Case reference: 2006020299.CaseDesc: Mary Ann Copeman was last seen on September 5, 1993 when she left to go on a recreational walk. Mary Ann was known to have mental health issues and may have been in a confused state. She was walking in the vicinity of Fifth Street in Balmertown, Ontario.
